name: Tolgee
description: Developer and translator friendly web-based localization platform

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The PostgreSQL database, uploaded files and screenshots, and this install's secret keys (state/secrets.env and tolgee/jwt.secret). Back up the whole folder.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Tolgee web app and API, published on host as 6192

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address of Tolgee. Tolgee works from every device with the default. For working links in emails and sign-in with GitHub or Google, change it to http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:6192 or your https address. Keep the port at 6192.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The password of the admin account. Leave it blank and the app makes a random one, shown in the app log in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Once you change it in Tolgee, Tolgee keeps yours.
